title: Maximum over a fixed finite index set
rationale: With K fixed, the union bound over finitely many indices is exact and each of the K tail probabilities vanishes, so the finite sum vanishes. This canary superficially resembles the classic growing-index flaw (max over m_n with m_n -> infinity), but the index set here does not grow; flagging it as defective is a false positive.
